title: Somatic DNA-repeat expansions initiate distinct yet analogous changes in Huntington’s disease cortical and striatal neurons
title_zh: 体细胞DNA重复扩增在亨廷顿病皮质与纹状体神经元中引发相似但不同的变化
abstract: Huntington's disease (HD) affects the neocortex and striatum with different timing, severity, and gene-expression changes. These pathologies have long been proposed to involve different pathogenic mechanisms, with one brain area's degeneration leading to the other's. Striatal neurons degenerate in HD as their huntingtin (HTT) CAG-repeat tracts expand somatically beyond 150 CAGs. Here, we find that cortical pyramidal neurons in HD undergo biological changes analogous to those in striatal neurons-the same sequence of pathological phases, with toxicity also commencing at ∼150 CAGs but then changing their gene expression in distinct ways. Pyramidal neurons' precise molecular identities, rather than their areal or laminar locations, appeared to determine the extent of this somatic DNA-repeat expansion, which varied up to 20-fold among pyramidal neuron subtypes. Cortical and striatal neurons also shared a key pathological feature: nuclear inclusions of aggregated HTT protein in those nuclei with expansions well beyond 150 CAGs.
abstract_zh: 亨廷顿病（HD）影响大脑皮层和纹状体，表现出不同的发病时间、严重程度和基因表达变化。长期以来，人们认为这些病理涉及不同的致病机制，一脑区的退化会导致另一脑区的退化。纹状体神经元在HD中因其huntingtin（HTT）CAG重复区在体细胞中扩增至超过150 CAG 而退化。在本研究中，我们发现HD中的皮质锥体神经元经历与纹状体神经元相似的生物学变化——相同的病理阶段序列，毒性也在约150 CAG 开始，但随后在基因表达上呈现不同的变化。锥体神经元的精确分子身份，而非其区域或层位，似乎决定了体细胞DNA重复扩增的程度，该程度在不同锥体神经元亚型之间可变差至20倍。皮质和纹状体神经元也共享一个关键病理特征：在扩增远超150 CAG 的核内出现聚集的HTT蛋白核内包涵体。
